prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium website workflow illustration, very wide 16:9 landscape, 2048x1152. Create an exceptionally polished art-directed 3D composition about turning a creative brief into an editable 3D scene. A single original contemporary courtyard pavilion is shown in three coherent stages from left to right on one continuous pale cool-gray studio floor: a restrained fine graphite wireframe and gray blockout of the building on the left, a detailed matte clay architectural model in the center, and a fully materialed beautiful architectural miniature on the right. The pavilion has a large circular opening, a curved cantilevered roof, a terraced plinth, blue-gray shallow water, a slender stylized tree, textured white plaster, brushed silver and subtle natural oak. Keep the architecture unmistakably identical across all three stages. The final scene is larger and visually dominant, with refined shadows, precise elegant edges, and soft late-afternoon studio light. Quiet neutral backdrop, generous negative space, clean editorial composition suitable for a minimalist creative software website. World-class Cinema 4D/Blender studio-render aesthetic, physically plausible materials, beautiful restrained detail. This is an illustrative workflow concept, never a software screenshot. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, arrows, UI, screens, frames, grids, floating icons, people or watermarks. No neon, no cyberpunk, no galaxy. Every object fully inside the composition with safe margins. The image itself should be the beautiful visual, no added marketing layout.
